jobs.title: Principal, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

The Company
Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be part of the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive workplace, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be a part of.

With ~150 million active buyers across 190 countries and over 1 billion active product listings, eBay is the world’s most vibrant and dynamic online marketplace. Founded in 1995, eBay Inc. connects people around the world, enabling them to buy and sell online. eBay Inc. is headquartered in San Jose, California. For more information about the company and its global portfolio of online brands, visit  www.ebayinc.com

About the team
We are responsible for setting the strategic direction of eBay: our ambition, where we play, and how we win in the market. The corporate strategy has a reputation of solving the most challenging problems and coming up with innovative and out-of-the-box solutions, with recommendations grounded in data.

We work very closely with senior leadership and have a high visibility. Team members can have a fast-track career in strategy or move into the business after 1-2 years.

The team is responsible for deeply understanding the needs of our core buyers and sellers and crafting the strategies that will differentiate eBay relative to our competitors. We work very closely with product, technology, and regional business teams to ensure the strategy is translated into action across the end-to-end customer experience. Our work can be divided into 3 main topics: 1) we develop eBay Inc’s strategy together with eBay’s executives, 2) we run strategic projects to solve key strategic issues supporting select executives at eBay, 3) we closely monitor the competitive environment & trends.

The opportunity

The eBay corporate strategy team is seeking a Principal, Corporate Strategy . Within this role, you will lead a cross-functional strategy project and a team of a few s trategy team members . You will work with key stakeholders from all functions across the organization to craft strategies and drive structured and data-based recommendations to action. In this role, you will have the ability to influence key elements of eBay’s strategy and to help shape the strategic direction of eBay, working with eBay’s senior executives. The ideal candidate has a track record of making pragmatic, concrete recommendations with real world implementation experience. It is critical for the role that the candidate has strong analytic skills and is excellent in developing creative/ out-of-the-box and well-thought-out solutions for challenging business problems. You can either build a career in eBay’s strategy team or use this as stepping stone into other business and product roles at eBay.

Role responsibilities:

- Project leadership: L ead cross-functional projects to solve strategic business problems, working with senior eBay executives. Projects are usually 2-4 months long, staffed with 1-3 team members supporting the Principal . Topics can span eBay’s overall strategy, category strategies, buyer/seller strategies or functional strategies (e.g., payments, ads) or other relevant strategic topics

- Insights generation: Work with your team and analytics/ data science support to define smart analyses and generate new, compelling insights. V isualize in simple and compelling ways. Use the insights to develop key recommendations grounded in data

- Strategy Development: Define and structure the core problem, understand status quo & competitive dynamics, define ambitions and value proposition and create recommendations for key actions to solve the problem

- Communication: Develop compelling and concise storylines to communicate team’s recommendation; prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadership

- People leadership: Develop a team of associates and managers to constantly improve and help them grow their career

Job Requirements:

- Intellectual curiosity

- Skilled in project management and strategy development, including project prioriti z ation, hypotheses development, financial and business modeling, strategic options identification, consensus building, and implementation

- O utstanding analytical capabilities (quantitative and qualitative) , ability to define relevant analyses in a hypothesis-driven approach, generating new & groundbreaking insights grounded in data

- Excellence in structured thinking , developing creative solutions to challenging strategic business problems. Creativity and “out of the box” thinking that drives innovation. Ability to “see around corners” and “connect the dots” that enable business to proactively drive business

- Strong executive presence and ability to communicate strategy clearly and simply. Ease with executive-level interactions . Ability to create clear and simple storylines.

- Proven track record to lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of key initiatives . Ability to lead, empower and mentor project team members

- Comfort in reaching out and prioritizing cross-functional collaboration in a highly matrixed environment

- Comfort in handling uncertainty

- Highly collaborative – be fun, and easy to work with!

Qualifications

- Proven leader with at least 7+ years of work experience - experience at a top strategy consulting firm is a must;

- Experienced project managers, currently working at top strategy consulting companies. Leaders who spent at least 2-3 years at a top strategy consulting company and then advanced their careers for 4-5 years at a startup or corporate

- Bachelors Degree required, MBA or equivalent preferred

- Expertise in technology and/or in e-commerce/retail is a plus

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
We love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work.. To learn about our Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/. #LI-AK1

Additional Details

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within eBay.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at  talent@ebay.com . We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations, Beauty
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Qoo10 is Japan’s leading eCommerce platform for beauty and one of the fastest-growing players, becoming the platform of choice for Gen Z in Japan. With 80% of our buyers being women, primarily Gen Z, who are passionate about beauty, we are at the forefront of shaping the future of beauty retail. As a leader in beauty eCommerce, we continuously push the boundaries of what's possible in the online space. From a beauty-centric cataloged database to a live commerce platform, we are transforming how Gen Z discovers and engages with beauty products.

We are seeking a member for the Operation Strategy team. The candidate is expected to drive further growth and innovation as we continue shaping the future of online beauty retail. The candidate will be a creative problem solver, passionate about the beauty industry, able to take ownership of key project workstreams with high levels of intellectual curiosity, and energized by new initiatives with a positive, hands-on attitude.  The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in ambiguity, brings an entrepreneurial mindset, and is able to balance strategic thinking with strong execution. Within this role, the candidate will have the ability to identify and execute cross-functional initiatives that drive business growth (including initiatives with eBay Global teams, live commerce, and other new business opportunities), refine Qoo10 operational strategy, effectively communicate with international teams in English, and deliver impactful reports and presentations.

Job Responsibilities include:
[Execution of Cross-Functional Initiatives]
- Identify and execute large-scale, high-impact cross-functional initiatives that drive business growth: such as live commerce, online/offline events, and new growth opportunities in the beauty business.

- Collaborate with multiple stakeholders, including international teams, on new opportunities.

- Enhance efficiency and operational excellence across the business by introducing and aligning best practices, processes and tools.

- Bring structure, momentum, and clear follow-through in ambiguous, fast-changing situations.

[Operation Strategy Development]
- Support development and refinement of medium-to-long-term operating strategies for priority programs.

- Translate business goals into actionable roadmaps, requirements, and operational playbooks.

- Build business cases and recommend tradeoffs (options, risks, dependencies, expected impact) to enable leadership decisions.

- Partner with stakeholders to move initiatives from idea to execution with clear ownership and milestones.

[Operation Analytics]
- Identify and analyze market trends, customer behavior, and operational challenges to diagnose issues and uncover opportunities for improvement.

- Drive impact by optimizing day-to-day operations, improving overall performance, and contributing to business growth.

- Analyze data and industry insights, competitor landscapes to inform and support decision-making.

[Market intelligence]
- Develop insightful market intelligence about key industry trends (technology, competitors, consumers, and so on).

[Reporting & communication]
- Prepare and deliver executive-level reports and presentations to Qoo10 and eBay Global leadership teams with compelling storytelling in English and Japanese.

- Communicate recommendations clearly and concisely to stakeholders across different functions and seniority levels.

Qualification Requirements:
- Bachelor's or equivalent experience or master's degree

- 5+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally in consulting, global eCommerce/retail, beauty, business development, trading house, or similar cross-functional roles. Experience that combines strategy/planning with hands-on execution is especially valued.

- Proven ability to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

- Strong analytical skills (ability to structure problems, interpret data, and drive decision-making).

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across diverse teams and seniority levels.

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in diverse, cross-functional, and global teams.

- Fluent level of English and Japanese language skill (reading, writing, speaking).

- Be self-driven, detail-oriented, and able to tackle complex problems in a structured and analytical way within a dynamic business environment.

- Positive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to take on new challenges outside one’s immediate scope.

- Able to build trust quickly and collaborate effectively in a multicultural, matrixed team environment.

- Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and slides (PowerPoint/Google Slides) for executive reporting

Preferred qualifications:
- Understanding of corporate finance and/or statistical analytics.

- Experience in live commerce, social commerce, marketplace businesses, or launching new initiatives is a plus.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at  talent@ebay.com . We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

jobs.description:

eBay’s Corporate Development Team is responsible for sourcing, evaluating, executing, and integrating the company’s strategic acquisitions, divestitures, investments and joint ventures.

The team works closely with eBay’s CEO, CFO, CTO, CPO, GMs and operational leaders to enable go/no-go decision-making for potential investments and acquisitions. We develop outstanding market insights and strong industry & venture capital relationships to proactively identify the most attractive M&A and investment opportunities. We assess opportunities to ensure a strong strategic rationale, assess the case for buying vs. building vs. partnering, align the organizational fit and integration plan, develop the business case, perform valuation, structure, negotiate and execute transactions.

The opportunity:
The Corporate Development Associate will report to the Sr. Director / Director of Corporate Development. The role requires a blend of strong strategic problem-solving, deal experience, and collaboration skills, in a highly dynamic business environment.

The person will be involved in identifying prospective target opportunities, performing strategic and quantitative analysis, conducting due diligence, determining appropriate valuation and structure, developing strategy for and conducting negotiations, driving activities to closure, and coordinating with our M&A Integration team.

On a typical transaction, the Associate will be responsible for the following:
- Preparing executive-ready presentations with strategic framing, analysis, and recommendations Developing insightful analysis of key industry trends (technology, competitors, consumers, regulatory, etc.) and inform the organization of their strategic implications
- Identifying and evaluating potential acquisition or investment opportunities in conjunction with the business and product teams
- Conducting rigorous valuation analyses (using multiple methodologies) and business/integration case modeling to evaluate and recommend transaction opportunities
- Quarter-backing due diligence for potential targets and evaluating due diligence results
- Facilitating and managing acquisition and investment processes with cross-functional groups that involve members from our business units as well as eBay’s functional groups such as Finance, Tax, Accounting, Legal and Human Resources

This role provides a unique opportunity to gain a deep understanding of eBay, our industry and to support transactions ranging from strategic investments and the related commercial deal, to smaller tech and talent tuck-ins, to larger scale M&A. The level of exposure will allow the Associate to develop close working relationships with the leaders at eBay, and can be an effective springboard for other operational roles at eBay, where global job mobility is encouraged.

Qualifications
- Dedication to working eBay's Hybrid Model with 3 days / week in our San Jose, CA corporate headquarters office.
- The ideal candidate for the position should have a BA or BS undergraduate degree.
- The candidate should have at least two years of relevant work experience at a top-tier investment bank, corporate development team, private equity or venture capital firm.
- Problem Solver. Our job is to help eBay make better business decisions and often those involve solving tough problems. We value intellectual honesty and the use of creativity to find practical solutions to solve problems on deals.
- Demonstrated subject-matter expert. We're deal specialists! We need you to be one, too! Being able to understand eBay's business, the transaction or project objectives, and then overlay that with your own deal and tactical recommendations is a critical part of the job.
- Confident speaking your mind. Our culture encourages open and honest discussion. You will need to demonstrate the confidence to speak up as a leader, with substance, recognizing that sometimes it may be uncomfortable to do so.
- Ability to drive projects/tasks to conclusion. We don't like punting a major decision. Decisions tend not to get easier by deferring them indefinitely. We are expected to help prioritize, create clear project plans, ensure there are owners for action items and a clear path to making the decision. This will often involve working across functions in the organization and the Associate must be able to work with colleagues across a broad organization in this regard.
- Curiosity. Curiosity, proactivity and resourcefulness are the natural repellents against poor decision making. The Associate will have a curious mind, not be afraid to ask lots of questions, and be keen to keep learning.
- Good team-mate. By virtue of the role, we work collectively with team members across the organization. We continually do our best to create an environment where other eBay colleagues look forward to working with us. We're always ready to "grab an oar", regardless of our role/level/title, and understand that the project as a collaborative effort.
- Ability to coach, mentor, and grow. The Associate should be prepared to give (and receive) in-the-moment, relevant, useful and honest feedback to team mates. The Corporate Development team strives to improve and being able to give and receive feedback is a core part of this cycle.

Location
- Our primary goals is for this role to be filled out of our San Jose Corporate Headquarters with 3 days per week onsite in this office.
- We are open to hiring the candidate out of our New York City office with 3 days per week onsite in this office.

Job Description – FP&A COE Finance Manager

About the Role

Here is a remarkable opportunity to become part of eBay’s FP&A Center of Excellence (COE) and invent the future of global Finance. The FP&A COE operates globally to centralize, standardize, and scale essential financial planning and analysis functions. This role within the Marketing Finance vertical will deliver outstanding FP&A results, improve financial processes, and enhance the tools and capabilities for managing Marketing investments.

This position focuses on delivering outcomes and involves managing a team. The successful applicant will directly handle critical FP&A functions while supervising, mentoring, and supporting team growth. The role demands strong financial knowledge, precision, operational accountability, and the ability to advance process and technology improvements from conception to rollout.

About the Team

The FP&A COE provides global FP&A teams and business units with centralized functions and expert support in month-end close, forecasting, reporting, financial analysis, and business performance management. The Marketing Finance COE partners with Marketing Finance, Marketing business teams, Controllership, and other cross-functional collaborators to produce accurate OPEX accruals and forecasts, month-end close reports, spending visibility, variance analysis, and actionable financial insights.

Key Responsibilities

- Own and complete core Marketing FP&A activities, including close, accruals, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and analysis.
- Act as a key point of contact for Marketing Finance collaborators, ensuring timely and well-controlled deliverables.
- Review and validate OPEX accruals, forecasts, budgets, and variance analysis, providing clear insights on financial performance.
- Partner with Finance and business teams to understand investment plans, cost drivers, risks, opportunities, and changes in assumptions.
- Build scalable reports, dashboards, analytical tools, and insights to improve spend visibility and decision-making.
- Lead or support the end-to-end development of finance tools, including requirements, building, testing, user acceptance, documentation, launch, transition, and stabilization.
- Drive process standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across FP&A activities.
- Lead or assist in moving Marketing Finance activities into the COE, ensuring defined ownership, controls, governance, documentation, and service expectations.
- Partner with Controllership and Finance teams to ensure compliance with US GAAP, internal controls, accounting policies, and audit requirements.
- Contribute to the development of the COE operating model, governance, performance metrics, and guidelines.
- Manage, mentor, and nurture team members while remaining directly accountable for execution, quality, prioritization, and delivery.
- Prioritise multiple priorities and timelines effectively in a dynamic, matrixed environment.

Experience and Qualifications

- Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience; CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, MBA, or similar qualification preferred.
- 6–8 years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial analysis, accounting, or business finance; Marketing FP&A or related experience is preferred.
- Solid understanding of accrual accounting, budgeting, forecasting, month-end close, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
- Proven ability to independently manage complex FP&A deliverables with accuracy, accountability, and strong attention to controls.
- Experience leading and mentoring team members while retaining direct responsibility for implementation.
- Experience leading process transitions, standardization, operating-model improvements, or automation initiatives.
- Experience developing and implementing financial tools, dashboards, models, reports, or automated solutions.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, spreadsheet, and presentation skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively across functions, levels, and geographies in a matrixed and evolving environment.
- Experience with tools such as Anaplan, SAP, BW, Tableau, Power BI, workflow platforms, AI, or similar technologies.
- Experience managing the full lifecycle of a tool or process solution, including build, testing, implementation, launch, transition, adoption, and stabilization.
- Strong dedication to quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
